description: On the green bedspread in front of a dark pillow, there are three large plastic building blocks: a blue block, a white block, and a small yellow block. The left hand and right hand move forward toward the blocks; both hands pick up the white block together, set it onto the blue block, then the right hand lifts and aligns the yellow block and presses it onto the top of the stacked pieces while the left hand steadies the base, and finally both hands release and pull back.
